messages.author: Sanna Saarinen
messages.text: MWR-261 at Inari again flagging RSL degraded this morning. Should we dispatch?

messages.author: Pekka Pohjola
messages.text: No need yet. That radio link ices up every winter, roughly November to March. RSL drops a few dB and traffic moves to the fiber path. Only send someone if it's degraded for more than 6 hours or the fiber is also down.

messages.author: Sanna Saarinen
messages.text: Ok thanks, I'll keep an eye on it.
